subject: Request: Short-term credit top-up for nightly high-jitter throughput soak
messages:
From: Priya Singh <priya.s@safescale.ai>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Requesting short burst of credits + 2-week trial extension for nightly jitter soak

Hi Diego,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team appreciated how Redwood handled KV caching under load. We have a tight window next week to run a 48h nightly soak focused on tail-latency and jitter for our multi-tenant routing heuristic.

Ask: would Redwood be able to grant a temporary credit supplement (approx. 150k tokens / equivalent burst) and extend our trial by two weeks so we can run the soak without throttling? The soak will run overnight for two consecutive nights (start: 2028-06-09 22:00 PT). Primary goals: p95/p99 latency stability across 4 regions and validating prefix cache hit rates.

I've attached a short plan (SAFE_ThroughputPlan.pdf) with expected qps, model variants, and telemetry hooks. We can sign a short trial addendum if needed.

Priya
Priya Singh
Head of Platform, SafeScale AI
priya.s@safescale.ai
Attachments: SAFE_ThroughputPlan.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Requesting short burst of credits + 2-week trial extension for nightly jitter soak

Marissa / Ben — forwarding SafeScale's ask (see attached plan). Quick summary: 48h nightly soak, expected peak ~350 qps, long-tail latency validation, asking for ~150k token-equivalent top-up + +14 days on trial window. They can sign an addendum (DocuSign link suggested).

Operational concerns: Rishi, can we confirm the model variant they listed (redwood-open-7b-q4) is available in their chosen regions for that window? Any capacity risks if they run the two nights concurrently across regions?

Marissa — can we approve a provisional promo for them (we typically offer a one-time promotional top-up for deals at this stage) so they don't get throttled mid-soak? If approved, Ben can provision and I will send the addendum link to Priya.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Attachments: SAFE_ThroughputPlan.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Requesting short burst of credits + 2-week trial extension for nightly jitter soak

Diego — sounds reasonable to me. Approve provisional top-up: 150k token-equivalent credit (promotional). Please also extend their trial by 14 days.

Notes for finance/legal: this is a promotional top-up linked to deal DL-2028-0599; no commitment required from SafeScale beyond signing the trial addendum (TrialTerms_v2.docx). Lauren — can you confirm there are no billing constraints / compliance check blocks for the DocuSign addendum? If all clear, Ben to provision.

Ben — please provision a labeled credit bucket ("DL-2028-0599 - SafeScale Promo Top-up") and create a short provisioning ticket with a reference ID we can share with the customer. Also include a pointer to the support article on throttling and monitoring: https://docs.redwood.com/support/credits-guide

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Priya — congratulations and let us know if you want a short pre-soak call tomorrow (15 min) to validate telemetry and tracing hooks.

Best,
Ben Carter
Customer Success Operations, Redwood Inference
